decision_conditions: The details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (Sustainable Drainage) fail to demonstrate that the proposed source control Sustainable Drainage System would provide sufficient attenuation capacity to adequately manage surface water runoff arising from the development. The Council's Flood Risk and Drainage Team advise that the submitted scheme does not achieve the minimum attenuation volume required for the site and therefore fails to provide an acceptable sustainable drainage solution. As such, the submission has failed to demonstrate that flood risk would be appropriately managed, that surface water runoff would be minimised, or that sustainable drainage would be secured for the lifetime of the development. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies F7 and F8 of the NPPF (2026), Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policies 21 and 28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014). In addition, regard has been had to emerging Policies SE1, SE7 and SE9 of the new Enfield Local Plan, to which appropriate weight is now afforded having regard to Policy DM4 of the NPPF (2026).
